It includes standard checkboxes indicating no written communications, solicitation material, or pre-commencement communications. The filing lists securities registered under Section 12(b), including common stock (PEP) and multiple series of senior notes (e.g., PEP24, PEP26, PEP27, PEP28, PEP28a, PEP29, PEP31, PEP32, PEP33, PEP34, PEP39, PEP50), all listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC. It also indicates PepsiCo is not an emerging growth company and thus the extended transition period for new accounting standards does not apply.

title: Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders.
heading: Item 5.07. Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders.
start_phrase: PepsiCo, Inc. (“PepsiCo”) held its 2023 Annual Meeting of Shareholders on May 3, 2023.
summary:
Summary of PepsiCo, Inc.’s 2023 Annual Meeting voting results (Item 5.07):
- Meeting held May 3, 2023; results correspond to proposals described in the March 21, 2023 proxy statement.
- Fifteen director nominees were elected.
- KPMG LLP was ratified as independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal year 2023.
- Advisory vote on executive compensation (“say-on-pay”) was approved.
- Advisory vote on frequency of say-on-pay: shareholders favored an annual vote; the Board decided to hold say-on-pay annually.
- Four shareholder proposals were defeated: (1) independent Board Chair, (2) global transparency report, (3) report on impacts of reproductive healthcare legislation, and (4) congruency report on net-zero emissions policies.
- Detailed vote counts, including broker non-votes, are provided for each item.
text:
